verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail documents automation rules that handle incoming mail the way you want, and a Zapier integration plus an API for controlling workflows. These are standing, event-driven automations, and any time-based scheduling would have to come from external tools like Zapier, so support is only glancing. Missing for 10: native scheduling or recurrence of jobs (cron-like or calendar-based triggers), documentation of what automation rules can do, published API docs (the OpenAPI, llms.txt and docs-md probes all returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
